title: Authorized women’s retirement-age rally at Aviator Park, Aktobe
reason: Reported gathering drew about 30 people, below the 50-person threshold.
notes: Azattyq reports about 30 participants at Aviator Park demanding women’s retirement age be lowered to 58 (S011, lines 76-83); partial TIPEK monitor reports the same approximate count (S004, line 42). No evidence of a larger simultaneous crowd.

title: Solitary social-reform picket in Uralsk
notes: Partial TIPEK excerpt describes Utebayev holding a solitary picket in Uralsk, with social-reform and party-accountability signs (S004, line 37).

title: Astana rally for sanctions against Kazakhstan and other political demands
reason: The contemporaneous report describes 'several dozen' participants, below 50.
notes: Azattyq report says several dozen activists gathered outside EU representation and Western embassies and records demands; TIPEK also says 'several dozen' (S021, lines 68-73; S004, lines 85-86). The target/demand is recorded but attendance does not meet threshold.

title: Planned election-related demonstrations denied permits in Astana, Almaty and Petropavlovsk
reason: Permit denials alone do not establish an actual gathering.
notes: The TIPEK excerpt lists refused planned March 10-16 and March 19 demonstrations in Astana, Almaty and Petropavlovsk (S004, lines 29-31,58,64); it does not report the occurrence of those specific denied plans. The actual Astana March 19 attempt is recorded separately as E005 pending threshold.
